purpose: Exact interface ledger for every construction-plane runtime dependency and acceptance target. It converts graph edges into owner-, contract-, failure-, and evidence-aware build obligations.
invariants: every depends_on edge appears exactly once as runtime_dependency
every validates edge appears exactly once as acceptance_target
owners and zones match canonical plane declarations
runtime cross-zone edges obey the zone DAG
acceptance edges carry evidence only and do not participate in runtime topological order
interface consumption never transfers target-plane state authority
target contract surface and failure contract are never empty
